scientific_target: Specified-geometry, specified-history magnetic coercivity, with independent calibration and actual magnetic functional output
acquired_evidence: 921 actual NIST FeCoNi measured output/XRD rows; compact FeCoNiCu source with eight normalized SQUID loops and four deposition conditions
strongest_incumbent: Ordinary GP/EI with same continuous spectra; known CAMEO phase partition and same-library NMF/KKR phase-mixture readout prior art
retained_result: On the one supplied NIST library, continuous XRD assists Hc search and prediction. Mean source95%-Hc observation counts 50.75 composition EI vs31.75 continuous-XRD EI across12 paired seeds; all921 spectra supplied upfront.
full_cost_gate: 921*c_XRD + Delta_other <19*c_magnetic; unknown physical costs and calibration prevent practical advantage claim
calibration_gate: No independent standard/repeatability in NIST data. Kerr optical coefficients do not identify absolute magnetization. Public raw-SQUID repair has processing/units/source-quality discrepancies.
transfer_gate: No matched repeated compositions under independently varied preparation; one-history predictions cannot identify changed-preparation response
